Retaining all three would enter those samples into the pooled meta-analysis twice: the combined estimates correlate 0.93 with the mean of the two splits while the splits correlate only 0.15 with each other. The splits are kept because the tissue-stratified analysis (06d) and the pain-model strata (06b STUDY_MODEL) both address them individually.

Sciatic nerve and dorsal root ganglia are both peripheral nerve tissue from the same animals, and their effect sizes correlate 0.52 across 847 shared features. Entering both would contribute correlated estimates to one pooled family, inflating k and narrowing the interval further than the evidence supports. The GSE241361 splits were kept because they correlate only 0.15; this pair is nothing like that independent. DRG is retained rather than sciatic nerve because it holds the primary sensory neuron somata. ST000676_Plasma is kept as a separate unit: it correlates 0.01 with DRG and 0.07 with sciatic nerve, so it is genuinely independent.

Peritoneal fluid and plasma are two compartments sampled from the same women, correlating 0.52 across 140 shared features, so the two splits are not independent units. Plasma is retained because it is the matrix the rest of the metabolomic corpus uses (serum or plasma in every other study), making it the arm that can actually join a pooled family, and it carries the larger contrast (73 v 35 against 54 v 35).

Same animals as the dorsal root ganglia unit, sampled in a second compartment. Their effect sizes correlate only 0.01, which is why both were kept at first, but uncorrelated effects do not make the samples independent: the pool counts study units, so one accession entered as two and k overstated the evidence. That inflated 29 of 103 features in the k>=3 family, and two of the six significant features (NAME:tg520mnh41108, NAME:tg502mna1020) reached k=3 on two accessions. Metabolomics therefore enters one unit per accession. The same inflation exists for GSE241361_DRG/GSE241361_Spinal_cord in transcriptomics but is immaterial there, where it adds 1 to k values around 50 and moves only 2 of 536 affected significant features below the threshold.
